2410: Using monitoring tools is essential to follow critical conveyor parameters continuously and accurately, such as operating speed, belt alignment and possible vibrations in the system. These measurements make it possible to identify, preventively, any deviation in operation that may indicate imminent problems. That way, corrections can be made before problems become critical, avoiding unexpected stoppages on the production line. This kind of monitoring not only ensures a more stable, safer operation but also contributes directly to extending the equipment's service life, optimizing maintenance costs and improving the system's overall efficiency.
2412: Do not put off replacing parts that show signs of wear, such as cracks, play or deformation. Ignoring these signs can result in serious failures, compromising the efficiency and safety of the whole operation. Damaged components tend to speed up the wear of other items in the system, causing a chain reaction of problems that can impact production. Preventive replacement not only reduces the risk of unexpected stoppages but also avoids additional corrective maintenance costs and extends the equipment's service life. Get ahead of problems and keep the operation running without interruptions and more safely.
